logoDirection: Use RETURN TO ONE PLACE in Cochin with a small repeated pair of vertical marks. No leaf icon or nature seal.

adaptations: A pocket version reduces prompts but retains date and conditions.

Keep the full name with any new symbol until the audience can recognize it independently.
